search.noneBody: Check the spelling or try searching for something else.

home.welcomeBody: Open files or a folder, browse your library, or drag files onto this window to start playing.
home.libraryHint: Player shows music from your Music folder and videos from your Videos folder. Add more folders in Settings.

library.emptyMusicBody: Player looks for music in these folders. Add a folder to show more music here.
library.emptyVideoBody: Player looks for videos in these folders. Add a folder to show more videos here.
library.folderExists: This folder is already in your library
library.gone: This item is no longer in your library

queue.emptyBody: Play something from your library, open files, or drag files onto this window.

playlists.name: Playlist name
playlists.deleteConfirm: “{name}” will be deleted. The songs and videos in it stay on your computer.
playlists.emptyBody: Create a playlist to keep your favourite songs and videos together.
playlists.emptyPlaylistBody: Use “Add to” on songs and videos, drag them onto the playlist in the navigation pane, or add media files.
playlists.nameEmpty: Enter a name for the playlist.
playlists.nameTaken: There's already a playlist with this name.

toast.addedQueue_one: Added {count} item to the play queue
toast.addedQueue_other: Added {count} items to the play queue

drop.queue: Drop to add to the play queue

errors.notSupported: “{name}” is in a format Player doesn't support.
errors.decode: “{name}” is damaged or uses a codec Player doesn't support.
errors.notFound: “{name}” can't be found. It may have been moved, renamed or deleted.
errors.noMedia: None of these items can be played by Player.
errors.folderEmpty: There's no music or video in “{name}”.

settings.foldersHint: Player shows music and videos from these folders and their subfolders.
settings.noFolders: No folders. Add one to see your media here.
settings.removeFolderConfirm: “{name}” won't appear in your library anymore. The files themselves won't be deleted.
settings.rescanHint: Look again for new, changed or removed files.
settings.visualizerHint: Animation shown behind music in the now playing view.
settings.vizAnimOff: Animation effects are turned off in Selene Settings, so the visualizer is hidden.
settings.resumeHint: Restore the play queue and position the next time Player starts.
settings.videoStageHint: Switch to the full video view when a video starts playing.
settings.cacheHint: Remove cached artwork, video thumbnails and song information. They're rebuilt automatically.
settings.cacheConfirm: Clear the cache? Artwork, thumbnails and song information will be read again from your files.
settings.aboutBody: Plays music and videos from your computer. Sample media © Selene OS, public domain (CC0).

home.welcomeTitle: Écoutez votre musique, regardez vos vidéos
home.welcomeBody: Ouvrez des fichiers ou un dossier, parcourez votre bibliothèque ou faites glisser des fichiers sur cette fenêtre pour commencer la lecture.
home.libraryHint: Le Lecteur affiche la musique de votre dossier Musique et les vidéos de votre dossier Vidéos. Ajoutez d'autres dossiers dans les Paramètres.

library.scanning: Recherche de musique et de vidéos…
library.emptyMusicBody: Le Lecteur recherche la musique dans ces dossiers. Ajoutez un dossier pour afficher plus de musique ici.
library.emptyVideoBody: Le Lecteur recherche les vidéos dans ces dossiers. Ajoutez un dossier pour afficher plus de vidéos ici.
library.folderExists: Ce dossier fait déjà partie de votre bibliothèque
library.gone: Cet élément ne fait plus partie de votre bibliothèque

queue.emptyBody: Lancez la lecture depuis votre bibliothèque, ouvrez des fichiers ou faites-les glisser sur cette fenêtre.

playlists.emptyBody: Créez une playlist pour regrouper vos titres et vidéos préférés.
playlists.emptyPlaylistBody: Utilisez « Ajouter à » sur des titres ou des vidéos, faites-les glisser sur la playlist dans le volet de navigation ou ajoutez des fichiers multimédias.
playlists.nameEmpty: Entrez un nom pour la playlist.
playlists.nameTaken: Une playlist porte déjà ce nom.

transport.timeToggle: Afficher la durée totale ou le temps restant
